title: PalmX 2025: The First Shared Task on Benchmarking LLMs on Arabic and Islamic Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' cultural competence and alignment to counteract Western/Anglocentric biases by using likelihood-based scoring on a benchmark of multiple-choice questions (MCQs) related to General Arabic Culture across 22 countries (covering traditions, history, geography, and customs).

Assessing models' intrinsic understanding of Islamic culture to mitigate under-representation by using likelihood-based scoring on a benchmark of multiple-choice questions (MCQs) covering General Islamic Culture (including religious rituals, Quranic knowledge, Hadith literature, and Islamic history).
